A trade off between GPC and refractive index, an already described correlation, 34 is shown for the TiO2 (H2O, 500 cycles) series, considering Figs. 7 and 5. The TiO 2 films further display the direct relation between the refractive index and the density. 48,49 The refractive index for WO3 films (not shown here) occurred in a range between 2.20 and 2.34 /C14 C.
